Resolves #21284

The claim responder now greets a claimant who has at least one merged pull request across the organisation with "and welcome back!", in both greetings (assigned, and first in line). Everyone else, including a claimant whose count couldn't be read, still gets "and welcome!". No other reply text changes and the workflow makes no extra API call. Public behavior: only the greeting wording changes.

Evidence: L2 (unit tier `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/`, 522 passed) -> L2 required (#21284 ACs).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `claimResponse.spec.mjs` "a claimant with a merged pull request is welcomed back in both greetings": a count of 1 gives "welcome back!" in `assignedBody` and `body`. The workflow scenario 1b (`total_count: 1`) posts "welcome back! Assigned to you". |
| AC-2 | The same spec: a count of 0 and an unknown count give "welcome!". Workflow scenarios 1 (`total_count: 0`) and 1c (the search throws) post "welcome! Assigned to you". |
| AC-3 | The new spec runs 0, 1 and an unknown count through both greetings. |
| AC-4 | A refusal renders identically with and without `welcomeBack` (asserted). Scenario 1b still makes one count query. |
| AC-5 | Unit tier: 522 passed. Without the source change, the two updated `claimResponse.spec.mjs` tests fail and the other 49 pass. |

## Deltas from ticket
The ticket passes `mergedCount` into `decideClaim`/`renderReply` and calls `standing()` there. `claimResponse.mjs` deliberately has no imports: the workflow spec asserts that "the claim module has no imports, so even a missing or broken standing module can answer safely". Importing `contributorStanding.mjs` there would also create a cycle, because that module reads `CURATED_LABELS` at load time. So the workflow, which already imports `contributorStanding.mjs` for `claimLimit`, computes `welcomeBack = standing(total_count).rung !== null` from the count it already fetched and passes the boolean through `decideClaim` to `renderReply`. The one-merge test is still `standing(count).rung`, and a failed, incomplete or invalid count leaves `welcomeBack` false.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in the unit tier.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The next claim from a contributor with a merged pull request reads "welcome back".
